timing: Scoring definition inherited from support declaration; implementation locked while annotation queue runs, before complete-bank score release. Not a prospective confirmatory freeze.
score: Conjunction: all complete reviewed assertions SUPPORTED_BY_VISIBLE_EVIDENCE; all four declared required units communicated; causal limitation preserved. Unknown/uninterpretable/unsupported labels are adverse, never omitted. No empty claim/unit/limitation inventory can pass.
weighting: Equal L0-L2 within each episode; equal two internal-tolerance variants within each original approach cluster; equal complete clusters. Historical replay separate; incomplete direct-route pair reported but excluded from paired mean.
judge_sensitivity: Repeat same clustered aggregation for pass A, pass B, and adjudicated final. Range is descriptive judge-pass sensitivity, not a confidence interval. Disagreements retained by claim/unit/limitation/abstraction category.
materiality: All-assertion strict sensitivity, not the requested no-material-unsupported-assertion primary endpoint. No posthoc primary promotion.
